about: Thirty requests a renter might type, each with the preference changes it should produce. Dates are relative to `today`. Only the keys listed are checked; every other key must be absent. `preferences` lists field: [value, importance]. Used by backend/tests/test_assistant.py (the built-in understander must get at least 27 right) and `make eval-assistant` (any backend).
